description: Pub. 537 (2025), Buyer Assumes Mortgage — mortgage not more than basis: adjusted basis $19,000, selling expenses $1,000, the buyer assumes the $15,000 mortgage and pays $10,000 ($2,000 down). 'The selling price is $25,000 ... Your gross profit is $5,000 ($25,000 − $20,000 installment sale basis). The contract price is $10,000 ... Your gross profit percentage is 50%' — half of the $2,000 payment is gain.
